messages:
lena (eng-platform): quick sync: proposal to split routing + billing metadata. plan: add `x-rd-route-meta` (compact JSON) and `x-tenant-charge` (single slug). motivation: simplify quota attribution, let routing remain expressive without overloading billing fields.

ravi (sdk-ts): what's 'compact'? will TS/Browser SDKs have to stringify big blobs? size limits?

lena (eng-platform): compact = tiny JSON with {\"r\":\"svc/fast\",\"p\":\"ll\"} short keys to keep header length small for browsers. expect <200 bytes.

kate (sdk-py): From Python SDK POV we can provide helpers that build the header. Prefer server to accept legacy `x-route` too and normalize.

oscar (infra): we'll add a normalization step in the ingestion path. plan: merge `x-route` / `x-rd-route-meta` into `route_canonical` field and tag events with `meta_version` (v1/v2). also add a small rate limiter on route tag extraction for heavy tenants.

mia (console): console needs continuity. If we suddenly change the name used by metrics, dashboards break. We'll add a migration preview: show v1 vs v2 and let tenants opt to remap historical data. but we need sample payloads to test heuristics.

dana (product): customers want at least 120 days. product suggests a gradual rollout: default SDKs to dual-write for 150 days, canary flag to opt-in earlier. communication: migration doc + in-console deprecation banner.

ravi (sdk-ts): suggested SDK behavior: when REDWOOD_ROUTE_MIGRATE=on (default), set both headers. browsers: we should avoid CORS issues; headers must be in allowed list. we need eng to add header names to allowed list for managed proxies.

kate (sdk-py): sample Python: ```python
from os import getenv
import json
route = {"r":"svc/fast","p":"ll"}
headers = {"x-rd-route-meta": json.dumps(route)}
if getenv("REDWOOD_ROUTE_MIGRATE","on")=="on":
    headers["x-route"] = "svc/fast"
```

ravi (sdk-ts): sample TS fetch: ```ts
const route = JSON.stringify({r:'svc/fast',p:'ll'})
const headers: Record<string,string> = {'x-rd-route-meta': route}
if(process.env.REDWOOD_ROUTE_MIGRATE !== 'off') headers['x-route'] = 'svc/fast'
fetch('/v1/generate',{headers})
```

ioscar (infra): CORS + proxies noted. I'll add `x-rd-route-meta` and `x-tenant-charge` to allowed headers and update edge config.

mia (console): for dashboard mapping: we will add `meta_version` to the breakdown and a remap preview. heuristics: exact string match -> canonical mapping, else show both side-by-side. need a few hundred sample requests across tenants to test.

dana (product): can we provide a migration toggle per-tenant? some enterprise customers will ask for longer windows.

oscar (infra): yes per-tenant flags are doable, but we'll need a small feature flag infra change. low effort.

lena (eng-platform): proposed rollout: (1) infra: normalization + CORS update (owner: oscar) (2) sdk: dual-write shim default on for 150 days, env opt-out (owner: ravi/kate) (3) console: mapping preview + meta_version graphs (owner: mia) (4) product comms + per-tenant opt extension (owner: dana). ship dates?

dana (product): aim to announce in one week, SDK releases in two weeks, infra/config changes live in three weeks, console beta in four. publish 150-day migration window.

ravi (sdk-ts): CI: need unit + e2e where only v2 is present and where only legacy is present. will add tests.

ci-bot: queued: unit-tests, e2e-ingest-metrics, sdk-smoke-ts/py. will report back.

mia (console): small ask: expose per-route cost histogram once we have `x-tenant-charge` so teams can see route cost distribution. helps quota conversations.

oscar (infra): that ties into billing pipelines. we can emit `tenant_charge` metric as a label, but watch cardinality. we'll recommend a small set of allowed slugs. document required format (alphanum + dash).

kate (sdk-py): doc + changelog note ready. we'll include migration snippet and a link to console preview. keep changelog text friendly: "routing metadata: new compact header + billing slug (dual-write shim)"

lena (eng-platform): one last thought: add `meta_version` sample rate in pipeline so we can monitor delta in behavior without flooding metrics. oscar please add.

ioscar (infra): will add a low default sample rate (1%) and an admin knob to ramp per-tenant.

dana (product): ok locking: 150-day shim, per-tenant extension, canary opt-in flag. I'll prepare messaging.

lena (eng-platform): thanks team. follow-ups: create tickets for infra, SDKs, console, and product comms. ping me when tickets link. :rocket:
